messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Rigel (RIG-421) - elevated 5xx rate on dedicated eu-west-1 pool. Affected endpoint: /v1/embeddings. See alert 98123. Initiating incident channel.
sara (oncall): I'm oncall and joining. creating bridge: https://meet.redwood/incident/1812345670 

mike (eng-sre): quick signal check — seeing a 48% spike in 502/504s from rdw-dedicated-eu-west pool over last 3m. kernel logs show repeated GPU driver rebinds on rdw-gpu-07 & rdw-gpu-08.
alex (account-eng): pinged Rigel CSM + CIO. Rigel reporting production impact for their embeddings pipeline; they sent sample request IDs. Need a short customer-facing blurb ASAP.
tara (support): ticket #SUP-7282 created; attached request IDs: rq_91f2a7, rq_91f2a8. Collecting any customer timestamps now.
sara (oncall): immediate mitigation options: 1) failover Rigel traffic to warm standby pool (eu-west-1-standby) 2) deploy fallback model variant (quantized) 3) roll back kernel driver on impacted hosts. Which is fastest?
mike (eng-sre): fastest = failover traffic + rollback for the two hosts. Standby capacity available for Rigel (reserved). I'll run traffic-shift plan if someone approves.
jess (product): need to confirm whether failover changes billing/SLAs for Rigel — Alex?
alex (account-eng): client is in Enterprise Dedicated contract, failover to standby is covered for incidents. Proceed. I'll notify finance later if needed.
sara (oncall): @mike proceed with graceful failover to eu-west-1-standby for RIG-421 routing policy. Then start rollback on rdw-gpu-07/08. I'll coordinate comms.
mike (eng-sre): executing traffic-shift now: 
```bash
# shift rigel route to standby pool
redwoodctl routes update --account RIG-421 --route embeddings --target eu-west-1-standby --weight 100
```
Applying...
(mike updates) traffic shift complete, health checks green for standby. error rate for Rigel down to 3% from 48%.

sara (oncall): starting kernel driver rollback on rdw-gpu-07 and -08. mike, please paste rollback command you want on runbook.
mike (eng-sre): rollback command: `sudo apt-get install --allow-downgrades nvidia-driver=470.82 -y && systemctl restart inference-runtime` — doing one host at a time, monitoring telemetry.
mike (eng-sre): rdw-gpu-07 rollback done, node rejoined, no OOMs since restart. rdw-gpu-08 rollback in progress.

statuspage-bot: Suggested public message draft: "We are investigating elevated error rates affecting embeddings requests for a subset of customers in EU (Rigel). We have enacted failover to standby capacity and are rolling mitigations. Users may experience degraded embeddings throughput; we will provide updates in 30 minutes."
sara (oncall): internal customer-facing draft for Rigel — please review and make it succinct/tailored: 
"Hi Rigel team — we detected increased 5xx errors affecting embeddings in your dedicated EU cluster. We immediately failed over your traffic to standby capacity and are performing host rollbacks to restore full capacity. Impact: 30-60% of embedding requests experienced 5xx; since failover error rate is down to ~3%. ETA for full restoration: ~30-45 minutes. Next steps: (1) continuing host rollbacks, (2) validating end-to-end requests, (3) post-incident report with root cause and mitigation. Contact: alex@redwood.com (account), sara@redwood.com (oncall)."
alex (account-eng): looks good. I'll send to Rigel CSM + their ops alias and match their SLA tone.
tara (support): customer notification checklist: 1) include sample failed request IDs 2) include temporary mitigation (use standby) 3) include expected ETA and follow-up report 4) provide dedicated contact line (phone). Draft ready to send when Alex greenlights.
sara (oncall): routing/escalation list for this event: 
- Primary oncall: sara (oncall)
- Eng SRE lead: mike (eng-sre)
- Account: alex (account-eng)
- Support lead: tara (support)
- Product liaison: jess (product)
- Exec notify if >60 minutes impact: emma (cto)

mike (eng-sre): postmortem notes (short): suspected driver regression from y-day kernel-driver rollout v2.1.4 -> observed rebinds/OOMs. Mitigation: rollback to known-good driver 2.1.2 and add isolation for dedicated GPU hosts to avoid broad rollout.
sara (oncall): ops checklist completed: failover done, one host rollback complete, second host rollback complete and healthy. Performing end-to-end validation with Rigel sample payloads.
mike (eng-sre): validation: sample requests now succeeding end->end. latency slightly elevated (~+20ms) due to standby profile.
jess (product): please hold public StatusPage update to include that specific customer name? Legal OK? Alex?
alex (account-eng): Rigel is fine with being named; they prefer a proactive tailored message. I'll include the tailored blurb and send now.
sara (oncall): final internal comms template for execs: 
"Summary: Rigel experienced elevated 5xx errors for embeddings on dedicated eu-west-1 due to GPU driver regression. Mitigation: traffic failover to standby and rollback of drivers on 2 hosts. Impact window: 18:21-18:47 UTC. Current status: service restored for Rigel; residual monitoring. Next steps: post-incident report and recommended change to rollout gating for drivers. Contacts: alex@redwood.com, sara@redwood.com."

statuspage-bot: Statuspage updated (internal draft posted) — Public update scheduled: 18:55 UTC.
alex (account-eng): customer notify sent to Rigel ops alias with tailored blurb and request IDs. they replied: "Thanks — confirm when full capacity restored and we'll run our downstream checks."
sara (oncall): marking incident: mitigation complete, monitoring. assigning postmortem owner: mike (eng-sre). mike will file RCA and timeline within 48h.
mike (eng-sre): filing RCA, will include telemetry, driver change diff, and proposed rollout gating.
tara (support): leaving follow-up to ensure customer satisfaction and confirm downstream checks.
incident-bot: Incident channel closing in 30m unless backlog items remain. :white_check_mark:
